name: fix_terraform_fmt_violation
description: Fixes inconsistent formatting in a Terraform file so it passes terraform fmt -check
prompts: The file main.tf in this repository fails `terraform fmt -check` because of inconsistent indentation and spacing around the `=` signs. Reformat main.tf so that `terraform fmt -check` passes cleanly, without changing any variable names, output names, or values.

test_setup_files.check_fmt.py:
import subprocess

proc = subprocess.run(['terraform', 'fmt', '-check', '-diff'], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert proc.returncode == 0, f'terraform fmt -check failed (exit {proc.returncode}):\n{proc.stdout}\n{proc.stderr}'

proc2 = subprocess.run(['terraform', 'validate', '-no-color'], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert proc2.returncode == 0 and 'Success!' in proc2.stdout, f'terraform validate failed:\n{proc2.stdout}\n{proc2.stderr}'

with open('main.tf', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    content = f.read()
assert 'variable "region"' in content, 'variable "region" missing - do not rename it'
assert 'output "region_output"' in content, 'output "region_output" missing - do not rename it'

print('PASS')
